question: Which component of a reciprocating piston compressor opens to allow air to be discharged from the cylinder?
solution:
The correct answer is __Outlet valve.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Outlet valve__ is a critical component of a reciprocating piston compressor.
 
• The outlet valve opens to allow compressed air to be discharged from the cylinder.
 
• The reciprocating motion of the piston compresses the air in the cylinder.
 
• When the air pressure inside the cylinder exceeds the outside pressure, the outlet valve opens automatically.
 
• The outlet valve ensures that compressed air is released efficiently and prevents backflow into the cylinder.
 
• Proper maintenance of the outlet valve is crucial for the optimal functioning of the compressor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Piston Ring:**

 
 
• The piston ring is a circular component that provides a seal between the piston and the cylinder wall.
 
• It helps in preventing air leakage during compression.
 
 
 
• **Crankshaft:**
 
 
• The crankshaft is responsible for converting the reciprocating motion of the piston into rotational motion.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the overall operation of the compressor.
 
 
 
• **Inlet Valve:**
 
 
• The inlet valve allows air to enter the cylinder during the suction stroke of the piston.
 
• It closes during the compression stroke to prevent air from escaping.
